items.line: An account posts a video it says finally reveals how a stage trick of making a live person appear works, and calls whoever designed it a genius. Not checked here.

The Associated Press reports that President Trump has put new Russia sanctions passed by Congress on hold, saying a waiver is in the US national interest. The post links to its story. Not checked here.
Sciencegirl, a science account, says schools in China show children videos of hard daily work such as construction and farming, to help them understand their parents' sacrifices. Not checked here.
The New York Times posts a breaking-news alert saying President Trump signed an executive order to exempt Russia from new sanctions legislation that Congress passed last month. Not checked here.

DeepSeek, the Chinese AI lab, announces DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 and says it has stronger benchmark performance, faster task completion and shorter outputs than the previous version. It says the model is live on its website, app and API. Not checked here.

Elon Musk, replying to Robert Scoble, says people will be able to ask the new Tesla Roadster to perform the tricks shown at its event autonomously, "as it will be sentient". He adds that Tesla will build a looping test track at its Texas headquarters. Not checked here.

Republican Senator Thom Tillis calls the Trump administration's move "beyond irresponsible" and asks what part of enforcing a law the Senate passed 86-11 it does not understand. He is responding to the reported order waiving Russia sanctions. See the story on the order.

Journalist Christopher J. Miller relays that Ukraine's President Zelensky says Starlink restrictions remain and that tests with vehicles sent into the EU show the speed limit applies only in Ukraine, which he calls a planned operation. SpaceX has reportedly told Kyiv it is a technical problem. Not checked here.
The Premier League says Liverpool came back against Brentford, with an equaliser from Victor Munoz and then a goal from Alexander Isak, per its post.
Fabrizio Romano, a football transfer reporter, says Enzo Maresca is the first manager in Premier League history to win his first 7 games in charge. A photo is attached. Not checked here.

French President Emmanuel Macron, in French, says there is no place for violence in the Republic, that people who broke and attacked prefectures and shops will be prosecuted and punished, and that he backs the police. The post as recorded is cut off. Not checked here.

President Trump endorses Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton for the U.S. Senate and calls James Talarico, spelled "TalaFREAKO" in the post, a "Radical Left Lunatic". These are his words and are not checked here.
Bleacher Report says Indiana receiver Nick Marsh was out of bounds on what looked like a winning touchdown, and that Ohio State won 19-15.

A French account posts a short video and says the Limoges town hall has been set on fire, calling it a scandal and a sadness. The post is in French. Franceinfo reports the fire during the 17 October protest day; the video itself has not been checked here.
ESPN says Florida beat No. 7 Texas in Austin after trailing 17-3, scoring 24 straight points, and that it is Texas's second straight loss.

A French account posts a 22-second video and says a crowd is targeting police vehicles near République in Paris on the 17 October protest day. The post is in French. The video has not been checked here.

Tim Sweeney, who runs Epic Games, says games that cost too much to make to earn their money back will soon become possible, and calls it a new golden age of gaming. The post does not say how. Not checked here.
Barstool Sports says Auburn won at Georgia. ESPN, attached, calls it a shock for the No. 1 Bulldogs and says they had won 53 straight games against unranked teams before this one.

The RapSheet account says sources told it and Adam Schefter that the Eagles are placing quarterback Jalen Hurts on injured reserve, after consulting doctors and experts, and that he is out for the foreseeable future.
A user says they looked up how much money doctors make in the US and found it shocking. The post gives no figures. Not checked here.

A user says there is a guy on Instagram who pours a whole pack of sugar on an ant hill to "give them sudden wealth, cause inflation and crash their economy". The post reads as a joke about economics. Not checked here.

ESPN's Adam Schefter reports, citing sources, that the Eagles are placing quarterback Jalen Hurts on injured reserve after consulting doctors and experts, and that the move sidelines him indefinitely. Not checked here.

Destination Télé, a French-language account, posts a 17-second video and says the town hall of Limoges, a listed historic building from 1876, is collapsing. The post does not say why. Other posts say it was set on fire during the protests; that has not been checked here.

BNO News, a news account, says officials report "significant casualties," including deaths, after an explosion at a Canadian military base in Wainwright, Alberta. The post carries a 10-second video. Not checked here.

The New York Times posts a breaking-news alert saying two people, including a child, were killed and several others injured when a truck drove through a soccer game in Wichita, Kansas, the authorities said.

Acyn posts a 51-second clip of an exchange in which Abdul El-Sayed is asked whether he will disavow the Muslim Brotherhood. He says yes, asks why the question is put to him, and asks the questioner whether they have disavowed it. The post does not say where or when it was filmed.

DiscussingFilm, a film news account, says Hunter Schafer reveals she is starring in an upcoming A24 vampire film, with Emma Corrin, Havana Rose Liu, Sophie Wilde, Fabien Frankel and Josh Hutcherson. It credits the Academy Museum. Not checked here.

Major League Soccer's account posts "MESSI. This is what he does." with an attached clip. In a separate post, football reporter Fabrizio Romano says Lionel Messi had two more goal contributions for Inter Miami that night. Not checked here.

Odyssey, an AI lab, says it placed a fruit fly brain inside its world model, Odyssey-3, and that the simulated fly now flies around imagined worlds by itself. The claim is the lab's own. Not checked here.

A user says he should start a class for new users, because many people still do not understand what Grok Bot is or what it can do. Grok is made by xAI, the company behind the model that gathers this page's posts.
An account says streamer QTCinderella teased streamer Ludwig after Clavicular got no Streamer Awards nomination, and quotes her remark. Not checked here.

Variety reports that Dancing With the Stars has pulled Val Chmerkovskiy after what the show called an inappropriate joke about a slap involving Carrie Ann Inaba, and quotes the show saying staff well-being is non-negotiable. Not checked here.
